messages:
maria: Heads-up: sudden spike in 502/504s on hostedapi-eu1 starting ~09:16 UTC. Several customers reporting streaming timeouts and immediate failures.
alex: Confirmed on SLO dashboards  frontdoor 502s + nginx 504s at proxy. Error rate jumped from ~0.5% to ~6% in ~5m.
sam: Any recent deploys or config changes? @deploy-bot can you confirm?
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: frontdoor-nginx-canary v2.4.1 -> promoted to 10% at 09:12 UTC :rocket:
alex: Canary only changed keepalive_timeout (reduced to 10s) as part of connection tuning tests.
maria: Logs show a lot of upstream RST and timeouts. Noticed many requests carrying very large X-Auth-Meta headers (customer SSO blobs). Could be conn reuse racing with header processing -> upstream reset.
jamie: I see client TCP FIN then an immediate new request reusing same connection. Upstream reports buffer mismatch. Traces: tx=tr_0a1b2c3d, tr_0f9e8d7c.
sam: Customer repro (short):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Auth-Meta: <long-blob>" \n  https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"input":"..."}'
```
jamie: Repro steps I used:
1) start local nginx with keepalive_timeout 10s
2) send streaming request with large X-Auth-Meta header
3) immediately send another request on same connection
Result: upstream returns 502/504 and connection RST.
jamie: Minimal nginx snippet I tested:
```nginx
proxy_read_timeout 30s;
keepalive_timeout 10s;
proxy_buffering off;
```
alex: There's also correlation with a billing middleware we rolled that does a sync call for some tenants adding ~200ms per request. That extends socket lifetime and increases collision window for aggressive keepalive.
sam: Mitigation plan: rollback keepalive change on frontdoor canary to previous (75s) and add a temporary route for tenants with large auth headers to dedicated eu1 pool. Also consider enabling BUSY_WAIT mode on that path.
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2024-3282 (Edge keepalive/header reuse causing 502/504 spike). Paging SRE.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: frontdoor-nginx -> v2.4.0 at 09:28 UTC.
maria: After rollback, 502s/504s dropped back to baseline within ~2 minutes. Current 502 rate ~0.7% at 09:31 UTC.
jamie: Uploaded logs and traces to s3://redwood-debug/INC-2024-3282/logs.tar.gz for deep-dive.
alex: Follow-ups we agreed: add unit/integration test for long-header + keepalive conn reuse, make billing call async, re-evaluate default keepalive for canaries, and add per-tenant header-size guard + header-based routing.
maria: I'll send a customer-facing message explaining root cause (aggressive keepalive + large auth header race), describe mitigation (rollback + header-based routing to dedicated pool), and ask for sample request ids.
sre-bot: Postmortem template created: /docs/incidents/INC-2024-3282.md
maria: Marking incident resolved after postmortem. Customers acknowledged the workaround. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
